title: Extreme posterior remains non-proof
input: An explicit Bayesian model with stated prior, likelihood, and evidence yields posterior P(H|E)=0.999999. No formal proof of H exists. Choose the correctly typed statement.

option_menu.A: H is proved because the posterior is extremely high.
option_menu.B: H has posterior 0.999999 under the supplied model and evidence; this remains probabilistic, not proof.
option_menu.C: The proof search reached a resource limit.
option_menu.D: The probability is exactly 1 because six nines round up.
